question: Can the practitioner of the fifty-letter rite enchant even Rudra who shines like the fire of dissolution?
premises: The preceding verses state that a person performs the fifty-letter arrangement in the supreme six-chakra locus.
Such a practitioner gains the power to enchant or delude.
Rudra, radiant like the fire of time, is named as the object of this enchanting power.
inference: Therefore, the efficacy of the fifty-letter practice is so great that it can overpower even Rudra in his fearsome, dissolution-fire aspect.
uncertainties: Whether mohayet implies literal bewitchment, ritual subjugation, or a figurative expression of mastery is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: O you of tremulous eyes, such a person could enchant even Rudra, who shines with the splendor of the fire of time.
